registration.email.title: Registration
registration.email.body:
Hey %s,

we’re excited to welcome you to Dulno! Before you begin your journey, we need to verify your account. Follow these steps to complete the verification process:

Click the link below to verify your account:
%s

After verification, you’ll have access to all the amazing features on Dulno.

If you encounter any issues or have questions, our support team is here to help. Simply reply to this email or reach out to us at support@dulno.com

Welcome aboard!
payment.email.title: Payment
payment.email.body:
Hey %s,

thank you for your order from Dulno. We are delighted that you have chosen a product from Dulno.

Your Dulno product is available to you immediately. Log in now with the login details you entered when you registered.

You can register under the following link:
https://dulno.com/login/

We look forward to working with you!
upgrade.email.title: Upgrade
upgrade.email.body:
Hey %s,

We have noticed that you have upgraded your Dulno package.

As a result of the upgrade, we have canceled your old subscription and activated the subscription for the new package.

In the course of canceling your old package (by upgrading the package) we have refunded you the last payment for this month in the amount of %s €.

It may take a few days for the refund to reach you. If you have any problems with this, you can contact support at support@dulno.com at any time.

We hope you enjoy your new package and thank you for your purchase.
password.set.email.title: Set password
password.set.email.body:
Hey %s,

there was a request to set your password!

If you did not make this request then please ignore this email.

Otherwise, please click this link to set your password:

%s
password.reset.email.title: Password reset
password.reset.email.body:
Hey %s,

there was a request to change your password!

If you did not make this request then please ignore this email.

Otherwise, please click this link to change your password:

%s
email.change.email.title: Email change
email.change.email.body:
Hey,

we have received a request to replace the email of one of our accounts with this email.

If you are not a Dulno customer or have not requested the replacement, please ignore this email.

However, if this is a genuine request, please click on the link below to complete the change:

%s
bundle.extension.email.title: Package extension
bundle.extension.email.body:
Hey %s, 

we would like to inform you that your booked Dulno package will be automatically extended in 2 weeks. 

If you do not wish to continue using your package, we would like to inform you that you must cancel your package manually to avoid having to make any further payments. 

We will not refund any money if you miss the cancellation deadline.

Of course, we hope that you will remain a Dulno customer if the product continues to help you in the future.

Thank you for your attention!
